author: Akien
prose: this is what we're going to do everywhere in the build process after the librarian works. anything that looks like a piece to try, we'll remove. we'll build a complete parallel you, but inspectable at every step. you and the clone working side by side on the same things, it learning every one of your calls and responses using hex. we'll find a thing that no matter what we try just doesn't work like you do, so we'll take it apart into components, fit each to it's own learning block, and try again. until we have enough data to point a finger at how to improve it.
